description: Utility functions for DOM element positioning, sizing, scrolling, and styling, part of the mozaik colorpicker library.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Calculates the position of an element relative to the document, optionally forcing visibility.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the width and height of an element, including border sizes.

methods.name: getScroll
methods.description: Returns the scroll position and size of the document or element.

methods.name: getMargins
methods.description: Retrieves the margin sizes of an element.

methods.name: getPadding
methods.description: Retrieves the padding sizes of an element.

methods.name: getBorder
methods.description: Retrieves the border widths of an element.

methods.name: traverseDOM
methods.description: Recursively applies a function to a DOM node and its children.

methods.name: getInnerWidth
methods.description: Calculates the inner width of an element, optionally including scroll.

methods.name: getInnerHeight
methods.description: Calculates the inner height of an element, optionally including scroll.

methods.name: getExtraWidth
methods.description: Calculates total extra width including padding and borders.

methods.name: getExtraHeight
methods.description: Calculates total extra height including padding and borders.

methods.name: isChildOf
methods.description: Checks if an element is a child of another element or container.

methods.name: centerEl
methods.description: Centers an element within the viewport along specified axes.
